purpose: Add an app-owned ACM candidate bytes/hash mapping gate that parses simple SHA256 manifests and verifies whether candidate input/archive entries are covered by matching hashes before any workload mapping or POD gate.

script.input: local ACM supplement zip with candidate bytes and optional hash manifests

behavior_locked_by_tests: candidate bytes plus matching sha256 lines choose candidate_workload_mapping_review
named candidate hash mismatch chooses candidate_hash_mismatch_review
candidate bytes without parseable hash manifest choose candidate_identity_review

pod_usage.reason: Hash mapping is still provenance review. Candidate bytes plus matching hashes require workload mapping before author/RTDL POD execution.

allowed_summary: Goal5337 adds an app-owned ACM candidate bytes/hash mapping gate. It can verify simple SHA256 manifest coverage for candidate files, but still requires workload mapping/review before POD.
not_allowed: claiming the real ACM supplement has been inspected from synthetic tests
claiming candidate bytes are exact paper inputs from hash matches alone
claiming exact paper dataset reproduction from this mapping alone
claiming Figure 5 reproduction from this mapping alone
claiming full X-HD paper reproduction from this mapping alone
claiming author-vs-RTDL performance ratio from this mapping alone
running POD directly from this mapping
